## Product
NexAgent AI is an automated flow system for South African SMEs — not a chatbot. From first WhatsApp to quote, job card, stock, timesheet and invoice, the floor runs in one thread. No extra apps. The owner talks. The agent does the admin.

5 AI agents plus 6 sub-agents that check and finish the work. The agents run on xAI Grok models.

### Agents
- Front Desk Agent: reads every WhatsApp a customer sends, works out what they need and passes it to the right agent or answers directly.
- Quote Agent: prices the job from your parts list, sends a branded quote PDF and checks every quote before it goes out.
- Leads Agent: answers 'do you do...?' questions and saves new customers into your leads list automatically.
- Job Card Agent: tells customers where their job stands and creates job cards when you text 'create job'.
- Invoice Agent: answers customers' invoice questions, builds invoices from your 'create invoice' or 'job done' message and checks each invoice PDF before sending.

### Sub-agents
Small helpers that check and finish the work.
- Quote check: checks name, phone and total before a quote PDF goes out.
- Invoice check: checks name, phone and total before an invoice PDF goes out.
- Create-quote helper: turns the manager's short WhatsApp command into a finished record.
- Create-job helper: turns the manager's short WhatsApp command into a finished record.
- Create-invoice helper: turns the manager's short WhatsApp command into a finished record.
- Part matcher: matches the part named in 'job done', even misspelt, to the stock list.

### Feature, not an AI agent
- Timesheets: clock staff in/out and work out day pay by WhatsApp.

### Chat demos on the page
Customer chat: a customer asks for a quote for brake pads for a VW Polo 2019. The agent says "Your quote PDF is ready. Reply YES to accept." The customer says YES, and the agent confirms the job card is created.
Manager chat: the owner says "Send Thabo the quote for the Polo brake pads" and the agent confirms the quote PDF is sent. The owner sends "James arrived 09:00" and "James left 17:00" and the agent confirms the timesheet is logged.
The demos do not show prices.

## Pricing — one plan only. Not VAT registered: no VAT is added.
- Free trial: 14-day free trial. We cover the setup. You only pay if you choose to continue after the trial, and nothing is charged automatically. The trial simply ends unless you say yes.
- Founder (first 10 clients): founders save 33% on the monthly and 67% on setup. The Founder rate is locked for 12 months, then moves to the standard monthly price at that time, with 30 days' written notice. After that, if our costs rise, the monthly fee rises by the same percentage, always with 30 days' written notice.
- Included every month: 60 jobs and 300 chats (a job is one quote-to-paid cycle). WhatsApp messaging fees are included.
- Top-ups: one top-up pack adds +250 chats and +50 jobs, one charge on the next invoice. Usage shows on the dashboard, with alerts at 80% and 100%. At 100% the AI keeps replying (never cut off) and the client is asked to top up. Usage resets monthly.
